title: FA/135/2012 of PRADEEP NAYAL Vs SMT. SHIVANI

paras.text:
SA No. 135 of 2012
U. C. Dhyani, J.
Mr. Lokendra Dobhal, Advocate present for
the appellants.
Mr. I.P. Kohli, Advocate present for the
respondents.
Defects stand removed.
Present second appeal has been preferred by
the defendants-appellants being aggrieved against the
judgment and decree dated 11.09.2012 passed by
District Judge, Uttarkashi allowing the Civil Appeal
No. 15 of 2009 and setting aside the judgment and
decree dated 08.09.2009 passed by Civil Judge (SD)
Uttarkashi.
Heard learned counsel for the parties.
Admit the second appeal on the following
substantial question of law:
(i) Whether the learned Appellate Court
has committed illegality in giving a
perverse finding regarding the
easementary rights of the
defendants/appellants?
 Summon the Lower Court Record. List after
the Lower Court Record is received.
 (U. C. Dhyani, J.)
 11.08.2015
SH
